scan.venueBusy: This venue has too many phones waiting right now. Please ask at the counter.
scan.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
scan.failed: We couldn't reach the pager. Check your connection and try again.
scan.venueNotFoundDescription: The link may be wrong, or the venue has switched its pager off. Please ask at the counter.

ticket.keepOpen: Keep this page open with the sound on. Your phone will ring when the order is ready.
ticket.acknowledged: Thanks. The counter knows you're on your way.
ticket.acknowledgeFailed: We couldn't tell the counter. Try again.
ticket.expiredHint: Ask at the counter if you are still waiting.
ticket.notFoundDescription: This link is no longer valid. Scan the code at the counter again.
ticket.showCode: Show this code to the cashier
ticket.notifyHint: Tap once so your phone can ring and vibrate when your order is ready. There is nothing to type.
ticket.codeExpiredHint: Scan the QR at the counter again to get a new one.

push.readyBody: Collect it at the counter of {{venue}}.
push.remindTitleName: {{label}}, your order is waiting for you

board.heading: Pager
board.subheading: When a customer scans your QR, their code appears under New phones. Type the order number or name on that card, then mark it ready to ring their phone.
board.enabledHint: Customers can open your pager link and follow their order.
board.settingsAdminOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
board.disabledNotice: The pager is off. Customers can't scan until you switch it on.
board.noAccess: You don't have access to the pager.
board.invalidTransition: This order has already moved on.
board.emptyNew: No phones waiting. When a customer scans your QR, their code appears here.
board.labelFor: Order number or name for code {{code}}
board.labelModeHint: What the cashier types on a phone's card.
board.qrHint: Customers scan this, then show their code at the counter.
board.invalidLabel: Enter an order number (letters and digits, up to 12) or a name (up to 40 characters).
board.labelTaken: Another open order already has this number.

poster.heading: Counter poster
poster.intro: Print it and put it on the counter. Customers scan it to get their order alert.
poster.noLink: Your business has no public link yet, so there is nothing for the code to open. Set a slug in your business settings first.
poster.stepScan: Scan the code with your phone camera.
poster.stepWait: Wait anywhere. Your phone rings when it's ready.
poster.callToAction: Get a ring when your order is ready
poster.stepShow: Show the code on your phone to the cashier.

display.scan: Scan to get your order alert

try.heading: Try the pager right here
try.intro: One side is your customer's phone, the other is the board at your counter. Play both.
try.stepPhone: The phone has just scanned your QR, so a code appears on it.
try.stepBoard: On the board, type an order number such as 42 on that code's card, save it, then tap Ready.
try.stepRing: The phone rings. Turn your sound on to hear it.
try.sandboxNotice: This is a demo. Nothing you type is saved, and reloading the page starts over.
try.claimHeading: Use it in your venue, free
try.claimBody: Create your account with your venue's name, then add its phone number. Your board opens with the pager switched on.
try.signIn: Sign in to switch it on

setup.heading: Set up the pager for {{venue}}
setup.intro: One last thing: your venue's phone number. Then your board opens with the pager switched on.
setup.phoneHint: Saved on your business. You can change it later in the general settings.
setup.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number with 6 to 15 digits.
setup.claimFailed: We couldn't set up the pager. Try again.
setup.adminOnly: Only the owner or an admin of this business can set up the pager.
